description: Top up your agent balance to speed up paid requests. The `amount` you pay here is not a per-call price: it is added to your balance and is drawn down across many future calls to tools such as `call_endpoint` or `buy_gift_cards`. When the balance covers the tool/endpoint price, calls are charged directly from balance without the 402 challenge flow. If the balance only partially covers the price, you still get a 402 for the shortfall - sign and retry as usual. Call once without payment: the response will be a 402 containing `accepts` to sign. Then retry with the signed payment. On success returns `meta.yourID` and `meta.historyUrl`. To use the topped-up balance: (a) for HTTP calls, send the `meta.yourID` value in the `X-Buyer-Id` header; (b) for MCP tools, pass the same value as the `buyerID` input property. `meta.historyUrl` returns your balance and calls history. Note: unpaid probes are limited to 15 calls / 10 min per IP. Call this tool if you plan to use our tools regularly, skip it if you only need occasional calls.

amount.description: Amount in USDC to top up (e.g. 0.5, 1, 10). Max 6 decimals.

name: top_up_balance

historyUrl.description: Direct url where you can get all your data. For more info look `get_my_history` tool description.
